summary: AudioCodes Ltd., an Israeli foreign private issuer, filed a Form 6-K on August 5, 2026, furnishing its proxy statement for the 2026 Annual General Meeting scheduled for September 9, 2026. The filing includes a notice, proxy statement, and form of proxy covering routine matters: re-election of two Class II directors and ratification of the independent auditor. The board recommends voting FOR all proposals. This is a routine meeting notice/proxy circular with no special-situation event, so it is mapped to no US special-situation category; there are no deal terms, transactions, or structural changes to analyze.
